$comment: Media the importer must sideload, and how page files refer to it. Blocks store ATTACHMENT IDS (fm_image()), and core blocks store URLs, so neither survives a move between sites. Page files therefore never contain a real URL or id — they contain a token, and the importer swaps it for the value it got when it sideloaded the file. See customer-runtime.md 6a.
